comparison.intro: Buying a wine before it is made available is not a TERWA invention: it is en primeur, a Bordeaux tradition. Here is the 2025 vintage of Les Demoiselles, today, by the two paths.

comparison.feat4: Certificate of ownership in your wallet, transferable

prices.title: Access to the best initial price, in full transparency
prices.intro: Your pre-order works out to 60.33 € per bottle excluding tax. The gaps below compare this access price with the initial market-release prices of the same cuvée: at the estate, at the official distributor, then as observed today at independent distributors. Then comes the life of the market: ageing, scarcity and demand move prices vintage after vintage, as the older vintages further down show, more expensive or now unobtainable. These prices do not depend on TERWA and may vary.
